not_held.segment_revenue: not held as figures (companyfacts carries no dimensions); stated in the 10-K's segment note and Item 7 — read_filings
not_held.product_revenue: not held as figures; stated in Item 7 and the product table — read_filings
not_held.geographic_revenue: not held as figures; stated in the segment note — read_filings
not_held.customer_concentration: not held as figures; stated in Item 1 / the concentration note — read_filings
not_held.backlog: not held as figures; stated in Item 7 where the issuer discloses it — read_filings

cannot.per_name_factor_sensitivity: the factor regression is over the BOOK's return; a holding's sensitivity to a factor is price.beta with that factor's ETF as benchmark (TLT for rates, HYG for credit), one call per name
cannot.scenario_refit: a scenario (book.sell / book.buy) re-runs the limit checks and does not re-fit betas, volatility or P&L: stated unmeasured

how_to_read: Every name under `table` is a figure you can slot {ref, name} or use as an operand (ref:name) in compute. `methods` are what compute can produce for this subject; `procedures` are how an analyst approaches a kind of question about it; `not_held` and `cannot` are figures this desk does not have and why — say so, do not substitute. expand=<domain> opens one domain's detail.
withheld: Some measures this run computed are withheld pending validation and are not published anywhere on this desk: expected_shortfall_95, stress_loss_credit, stress_loss_market, stress_loss_rates, stress_loss_tech, var_95_1d, stress_results. Say so if asked; do not estimate them from other figures.
